hero.title: Celebrity Edge Series Ships Guide
hero.subtitle: Celebrity Cruises' Edge Series introduced a new generation of ships designed around open-air spaces, distinctive accommodations, multiple dining concepts and innovative onboard venues. The series began with Celebrity Edge and expanded with Celebrity Apex, Celebrity Beyond, Celebrity Ascent and Celebrity Xcel. While the ships share the same design family, they are not identical. Each vessel has its own restaurants, entertainment spaces, itineraries and selected features. The later ships also build on the original Edge concept with additional outdoor spaces and refinements.

whichShips.footer: The series is commonly referred to as Celebrity Edge Class, although Celebrity Cruises generally uses the Edge Series name in its current guest-facing materials.

differentFeatures.title: What Makes Celebrity Edge Series Ships Different?
differentFeatures.intro: The Edge Series was designed to change how passengers use both indoor and outdoor spaces. Several features distinguish these ships from Celebrity's older Solstice and Millennium Series vessels.
features: The Magic Carpet on applicable ships
differentFeatures.note: The design puts considerable emphasis on connecting passengers with the sea rather than keeping outdoor areas limited to traditional pool decks.

shipComparison.title: Celebrity Edge vs. Apex vs. Beyond vs. Ascent vs. Xcel
shipComparison.intro: The five ships share a common design language, but their size, features and onboard details differ.

ships.characteristics: Expanded ship with additional outdoor space
Newest evolution of the Edge concept

shipComparison.note: For travelers choosing a cruise, the itinerary and departure date can be just as important as the ship because each vessel operates different routes throughout the year.

edge.title: Celebrity Edge
edge.lead: Celebrity Edge introduced the Edge Series concept.
edge.sub: Its design includes the signature Magic Carpet, a movable platform attached to the side of the ship that changes function depending on its position.
edge.note: Celebrity Edge is particularly significant for travelers who want to experience the original version of the Edge Series design.

apex.title: Celebrity Apex
apex.lead: Celebrity Apex is the second Edge Series ship.
apex.sub: It retains the core design introduced on Edge while adding refinements to accommodations, dining, public areas and onboard experiences.
apex.note: Celebrity Apex is a useful choice for travelers who like the Edge concept but want a later-generation ship.

beyond.title: Celebrity Beyond
beyond.lead: Celebrity Beyond expanded the Edge Series concept.
beyond.sub: It is larger than the first two Edge Series ships and introduced additional outdoor space and design refinements.
beyond.note: Beyond is especially relevant to travelers who prioritize outdoor spaces and a broader selection of places to relax.

ascent.title: Celebrity Ascent
ascent.lead: Celebrity Ascent continued the evolution of the Edge Series.
ascent.sub: The ship retains the defining features of its predecessors while adding further refinements to outdoor spaces, dining, accommodation and entertainment.
ascent.note: The newest ship is not automatically the best match for every traveler; the itinerary and accommodation can have a larger impact on the overall cruise experience.

xcel.title: Celebrity Xcel
xcel.lead: Celebrity Xcel is the latest ship in the Edge Series.
xcel.sub: As the newest evolution of the design, Xcel builds on the Edge Series foundation while introducing new and updated experiences.
xcel.note: Travelers interested in Xcel should check Celebrity's current ship information for the latest restaurant lineup, entertainment, public spaces and itineraries because new ships can introduce concepts that are not available on earlier Edge Series vessels.

magicCarpet.title: The Magic Carpet
magicCarpet.lead: The Magic Carpet is one of the most recognizable features of the Edge Series.
magicCarpet.sub: It is a cantilevered platform mounted on the side of the ship that can move between decks. Its position changes its purpose, allowing it to function as different types of spaces depending on where it is located.
magicCarpet.subLabel: The Magic Carpet can be used for:
magicCarpet.note: It provides one of the most distinctive visual features of the Edge Series.

infiniteVeranda.title: Infinite Veranda Staterooms
infiniteVeranda.intro: One of the most important accommodation innovations on Edge Series ships is the Infinite Veranda.
infiniteVeranda.sub: Instead of a conventional balcony extending outside the cabin, the Infinite Veranda uses a portion of the cabin itself to create a balcony-like experience. When the exterior window is opened and the internal doors are positioned appropriately, the cabin can feel more connected to the sea.

rows.infinite: Can extend toward the window area

infiniteVeranda.note: Travelers who specifically want a completely separate outdoor balcony should examine the deck plan and cabin category before booking.

keyTakeaways.title: Key Takeaways
items: Celebrity's Edge Series includes Celebrity Edge, Apex, Beyond, Ascent and Xcel.
Edge was the first ship in the series, while later ships refined and expanded the design.
The Magic Carpet is one of the series' defining features.
Infinite Veranda staterooms provide a distinctive alternative to conventional balconies.
Edge Series ships feature multiple complimentary dining concepts.
Luminae is exclusive to The Retreat.
The Rooftop Garden and Eden provide distinctive social and outdoor spaces.

conclusion.title: Conclusion
paragraphs: Celebrity's Edge Series represents one of the cruise line's most distinctive ship designs. Beginning with Celebrity Edge and continuing through Apex, Beyond, Ascent and Xcel, the series combines contemporary accommodations, multiple dining venues, innovative outdoor spaces and dedicated premium experiences.

The ships share important characteristics, but each has differences that can matter when choosing a cruise. Edge and Apex offer the original Edge concept, while Beyond, Ascent and Xcel represent later developments with additional refinements.
For the best match, compare the specific ship, itinerary, cabin category, dining lineup and included amenities rather than choosing solely by ship name or launch year.
conclusion.ctaText: Planning a Celebrity Edge Series cruise? Compare the ships, cabin categories, dining options and itineraries before choosing your sailing. Start with the route you want, then select the Edge Series ship and accommodation that best match your travel style and budget.

faqs.question: What ships are in the Celebrity Edge Series?
faqs.answer: The Celebrity Edge Series includes Celebrity Edge, Celebrity Apex, Celebrity Beyond, Celebrity Ascent and Celebrity Xcel.

faqs.question: What is the newest Celebrity Edge Series ship?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Xcel is the newest ship in the Edge Series. It continues the design and features introduced by earlier Edge Series vessels while adding newer experiences.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Celebrity Edge and Celebrity Apex?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Edge was the first ship in the series, while Celebrity Apex is the second. Both share the core Edge design, including the Magic Carpet and Infinite Veranda concept, but Apex incorporates refinements to the original design.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Beyond bigger than Celebrity Edge?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Beyond expanded on the original Edge design and has additional space and refinements compared with Celebrity Edge.

faqs.question: What is the Magic Carpet on Celebrity Edge Series ships?
faqs.answer: The Magic Carpet is a movable cantilevered platform attached to the side of applicable Edge Series ships. Its position and function can change depending on where it is located.

faqs.question: Do all Celebrity Edge Series ships have Infinite Verandas?
faqs.answer: Infinite Verandas are a major accommodation feature of the Edge Series, but cabin configurations and categories vary. Travelers should check the deck plan for the specific ship and cabin before booking.

faqs.question: What is an Infinite Veranda on Celebrity Cruises?
faqs.answer: An Infinite Veranda integrates the balcony concept into the stateroom. The design allows part of the cabin to open toward the sea, creating a different experience from a conventional exterior balcony.

faqs.question: What dining is included on Celebrity Edge Series ships?
faqs.answer: Complimentary dining varies by ship but can include multiple main restaurants, Oceanview Café, Mast Grill, Spa Café and other ship-specific venues.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Edge Series have specialty restaurants?
faqs.answer: Yes. Edge Series ships offer specialty restaurants, although the exact lineup varies by vessel. Specialty dining generally requires an additional charge.

faqs.question: What is Luminae on Celebrity Edge Series ships?
faqs.answer: Luminae is the exclusive restaurant associated with The Retreat. It provides a dedicated dining experience for eligible suite guests.

faqs.question: What is Blu on Celebrity Edge Series ships?
faqs.answer: Blu is a restaurant associated with AquaClass accommodations. It focuses on fresh, contemporary and wellness-oriented dining.

faqs.question: Which Celebrity Edge Series ship has the best outdoor spaces?
faqs.answer: The later Edge Series ships, particularly Beyond, Ascent and Xcel, build on the outdoor-space concept introduced with Edge. The best choice depends on which specific spaces and itinerary matter most to you.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Edge Series good for families?
faqs.answer: Edge Series ships offer pools, entertainment, activities, dining and public spaces that can appeal to families. Families should compare the specific ship's activities, cabin configuration and itinerary before booking.

faqs.question: Which Celebrity Edge Series ship should first-time cruisers choose?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Edge, Apex, Beyond, Ascent and Xcel can all suit first-time cruisers. The best choice depends on itinerary, sailing date, cabin preference, dining options and budget rather than ship age alone.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Celebrity Edge Series and Solstice Series ships?
faqs.answer: The Edge Series uses a newer design focused on features such as Infinite Verandas, the Magic Carpet, multiple main dining restaurants and expanded outdoor spaces, while Solstice Series ships use an earlier and more traditional Celebrity design.
